column1: # projected-look[turn]: fitted on 622 recorded matches, scored on 283 others (docs/notes/prediction_fit.md).
# Realistic delay: look error 3.23 -> 2.67 deg, position 1.42 -> 1.37 cm (mean), against hold-last.
# Keys: the newest input node's mask carried on unchanged (what the game does).
# Look: one projected input at the newest node's tick + 50 ms, made again every
# frame and taken out before each confirmed move: yaw turn = the node's yaw turn
# x yaw_gain / 64, pitch likewise. A bucket holds from <= x < to;
# turn = |yaw turn| + |pitch turn| of the node (radians). No projection while now is in
# the node's own tick, nor for a node 24 ticks (1.2 s) old or more.
